name: repository-governance
description: Audit-first GitHub repository governance with a safe path to apply merge policy and rulesets.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and apply GitHub repository policy
interface.longDescription: Audit GitHub repository and organization governance — rulesets, protected branches, reviews, checks, signing, merge methods, CODEOWNERS, templates, security features, and dependency updates — and propose a reversible plan, then optionally apply Tashtit's standard merge policy and a reviewed ruleset with explicit confirmation and recorded rollback. A router skill dispatches audit versus apply; each mode is its own skill.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's GitHub settings and propose a reversible policy plan.
